subject: Women's History Month Assembly
overview: Medford High School hosted an assembly for Women's History Month featuring student-led introductions and a panel discussion with prominent women leaders in law, military, science, government, and business.

items.title: Welcome and Opening Remarks
items.summary: Paul D'Alleva welcomed students and guests to the assembly celebrating Women's History Month and introduced participating leaders.

items.title: Remarks from Superintendent and Mayor
items.summary: Superintendent Dr. Marice Edouard-Vincent and Mayor Breanna Lungo-Koehn delivered opening remarks encouraging students to advocate for themselves and overcome adversity.

items.title: Introductions of Featured Panelists
items.summary: Medford High School students presented biographical introductions for an invited panel of accomplished female leaders across public service, science, journalism, and entrepreneurship.

items.title: Panel Discussion and Q&A
items.summary: Panelists answered questions from students regarding power structures, pushing for systemic change, overcoming imposter syndrome, and advice for their younger selves.

items.title: Closing Acknowledgments
items.summary: Organizers provided final words of advice and thanked the panelists, staff coordinators, and student volunteers.
